replies.body: if you have an issue with it then bring it up elsewhere. I have played avicus a lot more than the web says, as well as having spent a lot of time assisting with things other than playing on the server. just because someone doesn't physically play on the server doesn't mean that they aren't any less deservant of positions. I applied, the senior staff team had every right to deny me, but they obviously saw potential in me and gave me a shot. If this is stemming off of you not getting accepted or something I had nothing to do with it, but its not like i just applied -> insta jr mod.
